claims.summary: Register-file or configuration-holding module for I2C/IIC controller
claims.subject: m3s003fb
claims.explanation: Module has 4 data inputs (ADDRESS, Data, Status, WDATA) and 6 data outputs (CCRFS, CCRH, RDATA, SLAA, WrData, XSLA). No event inputs or outputs. No control inputs or outputs. No reset port. This pattern matches a register file that stores and provides configuration/status values for an I2C controller, with ADDRESS likely selecting internal registers.

claims.summary: Register select address for internal register file
claims.subject: ADDRESS
claims.explanation: 3-bit ADDRESS input with no event qualifiers suggests it selects one of up to 8 internal registers for read/write operations. This is typical for I2C controller register files where ADDRESS maps to specific control/status registers.

claims.summary: External data and status inputs for register file storage
claims.subject: Data and Status inputs
claims.explanation: Data (8-bit) and Status (5-bit) inputs likely provide external status information or data to be stored in the register file. Their exact mapping to output registers (CCRFS, CCRH, SLAA, XSLA) requires RTL source review.

claims.summary: Single-bit write data or write strobe output
claims.subject: WrData output
claims.explanation: 1-bit WrData output suggests it may be a write strobe or single-bit data signal for an external component, rather than a multi-bit data bus. Its exact role requires RTL source review.
